visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young male creator positioned in a small rectangular inset at the top right of the frame. He is wearing black-rimmed glasses and a black t-shirt, resting his chin on his hand with a contemplative expression. The main screen displays a stylized golden rank emblem with wings and purple gems, accompanied by traditional Chinese text indicating a '99-star' master rank. (2) The scene transitions into a fast-paced screen recording of the mobile game Arena of Valor. A green frog-like character moves through a lush, green jungle environment characterized by winding paths and stone structures. The creator's face remains visible in the corner, now reacting with more animation as he observes the gameplay. Colorful particle effects and UI health bars are scattered across the screen. (3) A chaotic team fight erupts near a defensive tower. The green frog character is surrounded by multiple enemy heroes, triggering a flurry of purple, blue, and yellow light effects. The creator leans forward slightly, his eyes tracking the action intensely while a slight smile appears on his face. Subtitles in white and yellow appear frequently at the bottom of the frame. (4) The gameplay shifts to a different area of the map where a character uses an electrical dash ability, creating bright yellow arcs of energy. The lighting in the game environment is bright and saturated. The creator in the inset laughs and gestures slightly with his free hand, appearing impressed by the tactical maneuver shown on the main display. (5) The frog character uses a stealth ability, turning semi-transparent and leaving a green wake. The camera follows the action closely as the character initiates another engagement. Text overlays like '+200g' and kill streak notifications pop up in the center-top. The creator nods in approval, his expression showing high engagement with the on-screen events. (6) The final sequence shows the aftermath of a successful play. The camera pans across the map as characters move toward the next objective. The creator offers a final enthusiastic reaction, his mouth open as if speaking praise. Social media handles for YouTube, TikTok, and Facebook are consistently displayed at the bottom of the screen in a banner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in Traditional Chinese with a clear, calm narration tone. A very subtle background hum is present, but the overall signal is studio-clean. There is no background music initially, only the dry vocal track. (2) Fast-paced, high-energy electronic background music enters the mix. It features a heavy synthesizer bassline and a steady 128 BPM electronic drum beat. Simultaneously, digital UI sound effects from the game, including soft clicks and menu pings, are audible. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition into a combat sequence. The male speaker's voice rises in pitch and arousal, exclaiming with excitement. Rapid percussion and explosive sound effects (booms and claps) accompany the on-screen game abilities. (4) The speaker's delivery becomes more rhythmic, almost following the beat of the BGM. He uses tactical terms with sharp articulation. Digital impact SFX occur frequently, indicating successful hits in the game environment. (5) A distinct meme-style 'ding' sound effect plays to emphasize a specific clever move. The BGM remains constant, while the speaker's vocal tone shifts to a more teasing, humorous quality, accompanied by a soft laugh. (6) The video concludes with a loud, enthusiastic exclamation ('Wa-cao') followed by a rapid-fire closing statement. The BGM swells slightly in volume during the final seconds before a clean hard cut to silence.
